cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women diagnosed with Premature Rupture of Membranes (PROM).
finding: The study found that 66.1% of patients received antibiotics, Dexamethasone was given to 32.1%, and 28% underwent caesarean section, primarily due to failed induction.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 28% of patients, with 50% of these due to failed induction, and other indications including macrosomia, previous scars, drained liquor, previous C/S, and breech presentation.
cross-section timing: Data was collected during the period of diagnosis and management of PROM, leading up to and including delivery.
